value.answer: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now includes persistent memory and Ollama integration. Copilot memory retains and recalls useful information across chat sessions, maintaining context between conversations. Ollama is available as a bring your own key provider, allowing for local model access and configuration within the JetBrains environment.
